38
Wɔyɛ Ɔhyeɛ Afɔrebukyia no
(Eksodɔs 27.1-8)
1 # Eks 27.1-8 Na ɔde okuo yɛɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia no, ne tentene yɛ basafa mmienu ne fa, ne tɛtrɛtɛ yɛ basafa mmienu ne fa, ɛyɛ ahinanan, na ne sorokorɔ yɛ basafa baako ne fa. 2Na ɔyɛɛ ne mmɛn, ne mfatorɔ nnan no so, emu ara na na ne mmɛn no tuatua, na ɔde kɔbere mfrafraeɛ duraa ho. 3Na ɔyɛɛ afɔrebukyia no ho nnoɔma nyinaa: Nsenaa ne sesa adeɛ ne nkoraa, adinam ne nsramma kukuwa no; ɛho nnoɔma nyinaa, ɔde kɔbere mfrafraeɛ na ɛyɛeɛ. 4Na ɔnwonoo afɔrebukyia no ho kɔbere mfrafraeɛ ntentan a wɔanwono no sɛ atena, ne bamma no ase firi fam kɔduru mfimfini. 5Na ɔguu nkaa nnan tuatuaa kɔbere mfrafraeɛ ntentan no ntwea nnan no so, sɛ ɛnyɛ mpoma no hyehyɛbea. 6Na ɔde okuo senee mpoma, na ɔde kɔbere mfrafraeɛ duraduraa ho. 7Na ɔde mpoma no wurawuraa nkaa no mu afɔrebukyia no nkyɛn nkyɛn na wɔde asoa. Ɔde ntaaboɔ na ɛyɛeɛ, na emu da kwan.
Wɔyɛ kuduo ne adihɔ
(Eksodɔs 30.18)
8 # Eks 30.18-21 Na ɔde kɔbere mfrafraeɛ yɛɛ kuduo no, na ne ntaaseɛ nso yɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ a ɔnya firii mmaa a wɔba bɛsom, ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano, no kɔbere mfrafraeɛ nhwehwɛ mu.
9 # Eks 27.9-19 Na ɔyɛɛ adihɔ no: Anafoɔ fam a ɛkyerɛ adihɔ ntwamutam a wɔde asaawa fitaa a wɔafira anwono, basafa aduonum, 10ne n’adum aduonu ne ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ nnyinasoɔ aduonu, adum no mprɛngo ne ne mmeaeɛ yɛ dwetɛ; 11ne atifi fam ntwamutam no, basafa aduonum, n’adum aduonu ne ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ nnyinasoɔ aduonu, adum no nnadewa ne ne mmeaeɛ yɛ dwetɛ; 12ne atɔeɛ fam ntwamutam no basafa aduonu nnum, n’adum du ne ne nnyinasoɔ du, adum no nkɔtɔkorɔ ne ne mmeamu yɛ dwetɛ; 13ne anim fam a ɛkyerɛ apueeɛ deɛ, basafa aduonu nnum, 14ɔfa ha ntwamutam basafa nson ne fa, n’adum mmiɛnsa ne ne nnyinasoɔ mmiɛnsa; 15na ɔfa baako no deɛ nso adihɔ no aboboano ɔfa ha ne ha ntwamutam basafa nson ne fa, n’adum mmiɛnsa ne ne nnyinasoɔ mmiɛnsa. 16Adihɔ no ntwamutam a ɛtwa ho hyia nyinaa, asaawa fitaa a wɔafira na wɔde yɛeɛ, 17na adum no yɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ, adum no mprɛngo ne ne mmeamu yɛ dwetɛ, ne tiri nnuraho yɛ dwetɛ; adihɔ no adum nyinaa, dwetɛ mmeaeɛ na ɛbeabea ho; 18na adihɔ no aboboano nkataano no yɛ adenwono adwuma a wɔde bibire ne asaawa a ɛbere dum ne koogyan ne asaawa fitaa a wɔafira na ayɛ, na ne tentene yɛ basafa du, na ne sorokorɔ wɔ ne trɛ mu yɛ basafa mmienu ne fa, te sɛ adihɔ no ho ntwamutam no; 19na n’adum nnan, ne ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ nnyinasoɔ nnan, ne nnadewa yɛ dwetɛ, na ne tiri nnuraho ne ne mmeamu yɛ dwetɛ. 20Na tenabea no ne adihɔ no ho mpɛɛwa a ɛtwa ho hyia no nyinaa yɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ.
Ɔman no ayɛyɛdeɛ no anobuo
21 # Num 4.28 Yei ne tenabea no, adanseɛ tenabea no ho nnoɔma anobuo, sɛdeɛ wɔnam Mose anomu asɛm so maa Ɔsɔfoɔ Aaron ba Itamar buu ano maa Lewifoɔ som no. 22#Eks 31.1-11 Na Hur ba Uri ba Besalel a ɔfiri Yuda abusuakuo mu no yɛɛ deɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no nyinaa; 23na deɛ ɔka ne ho ne Ahisamak ba Oholiab a ɔfiri Dan abusuakuo mu a ɔyɛ sika ne dua dwumfoɔ ne ɔnwomfoɔ a ɔde bibire ne asaawa a ɛbere dum ne koogyan ne asaawa fitaa mu adwini no.
24 # Eks 30.13 Sika a wɔde yɛɛ adwuma no nyinaa, kronkronbea no ho nnwuma nyinaa, ɛtoɔ sika no, ano si dwetikɛseɛ aduonu nkron ne nnwetɛbena ahanson aduasa, sɛdeɛ kronkronbea dwetɛbena no teɛ. 25Na asafo no mu nnipa a wɔkan wɔn no dwetɛ ano si dwetikɛseɛ ɔha ne nnwetɛbena apem ahanson aduɔson nnum, sɛdeɛ kronkronbea dwetɛbena no teɛ. 26Wɔn a wɔkan wɔn fraa dodoɔ no mu a wɔadi mfirinhyia aduonu anaa deɛ ɛboro saa a wɔyɛ mpem ahansia ne mpensa ne ahanum aduonum no mu biara yii beka baako (a ɛyɛ dwetɛbena fa sɛdeɛ kronkronbea dwetɛbena no teɛ). 27Na wɔde dwetɛ dwetikɛseɛ ɔha no guu kronkronbea no nnyinasoɔ ne ntwamutam no nnyinasoɔ no, nnyinasoɔ ɔha no yɛ dwetikɛseɛ ɔha, dwetikɛseɛ baako yɛ nnyinasoɔ baako. 28Na nnwetɛbena apem ahanson aduɔson nnum no, ɔde yɛɛ adum no mprɛngo, na ɔde bi duraduraa etire tire, na ɔde bi beabeaa ho. 29Na ɛtoɔ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ no ano si dwetikɛseɛ aduɔson ne nnwetɛbena mpem mmienu ahanan. 30Na ɛno na ɔde yɛɛ ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano nnyinasoɔ ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ afɔrebukyia ne ɛho kɔbere mfrafraeɛ ntentan ne afɔrebukyia no ho nnoɔma nyinaa, 31ne adihɔ no nnyinasoɔ a ɛtwa ho hyia, ne adihɔ no aboboano nnyinasoɔ, ne tenabea no ho mpɛɛwa nyinaa, ne adihɔ no mpɛɛwa a ɛtwa ho hyia nyinaa.

Na ɔde okuo yɛɛ ɔhyeɛ afɔrebukyia no, ne tentene yɛ basafa mmienu ne fa, ne tɛtrɛtɛ yɛ basafa mmienu ne fa, ɛyɛ ahinanan, na ne sorokorɔ yɛ basafa baako ne fa. Na ɔyɛɛ ne mmɛn, ne mfatorɔ nnan no so, emu ara na na ne mmɛn no tuatua, na ɔde kɔbere mfrafraeɛ duraa ho. Na ɔyɛɛ afɔrebukyia no ho nnoɔma nyinaa: Nsenaa ne sesa adeɛ ne nkoraa, adinam ne nsramma kukuwa no; ɛho nnoɔma nyinaa, ɔde kɔbere mfrafraeɛ na ɛyɛeɛ. Na ɔnwonoo afɔrebukyia no ho kɔbere mfrafraeɛ ntentan a wɔanwono no sɛ atena, ne bamma no ase firi fam kɔduru mfimfini. Na ɔguu nkaa nnan tuatuaa kɔbere mfrafraeɛ ntentan no ntwea nnan no so, sɛ ɛnyɛ mpoma no hyehyɛbea. Na ɔde okuo senee mpoma, na ɔde kɔbere mfrafraeɛ duraduraa ho. Na ɔde mpoma no wurawuraa nkaa no mu afɔrebukyia no nkyɛn nkyɛn na wɔde asoa. Ɔde ntaaboɔ na ɛyɛeɛ, na emu da kwan.


Na ɔde kɔbere mfrafraeɛ yɛɛ kuduo no, na ne ntaaseɛ nso yɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ a ɔnya firii mmaa a wɔba bɛsom, ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano, no kɔbere mfrafraeɛ nhwehwɛ mu.
Na ɔyɛɛ adihɔ no: Anafoɔ fam a ɛkyerɛ adihɔ ntwamutam a wɔde asaawa fitaa a wɔafira anwono, basafa aduonum, ne n’adum aduonu ne ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ nnyinasoɔ aduonu, adum no mprɛngo ne ne mmeaeɛ yɛ dwetɛ; ne atifi fam ntwamutam no, basafa aduonum, n’adum aduonu ne ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ nnyinasoɔ aduonu, adum no nnadewa ne ne mmeaeɛ yɛ dwetɛ; ne atɔeɛ fam ntwamutam no basafa aduonu nnum, n’adum du ne ne nnyinasoɔ du, adum no nkɔtɔkorɔ ne ne mmeamu yɛ dwetɛ; ne anim fam a ɛkyerɛ apueeɛ deɛ, basafa aduonu nnum, ɔfa ha ntwamutam basafa nson ne fa, n’adum mmiɛnsa ne ne nnyinasoɔ mmiɛnsa; na ɔfa baako no deɛ nso adihɔ no aboboano ɔfa ha ne ha ntwamutam basafa nson ne fa, n’adum mmiɛnsa ne ne nnyinasoɔ mmiɛnsa. Adihɔ no ntwamutam a ɛtwa ho hyia nyinaa, asaawa fitaa a wɔafira na wɔde yɛeɛ, na adum no yɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ, adum no mprɛngo ne ne mmeamu yɛ dwetɛ, ne tiri nnuraho yɛ dwetɛ; adihɔ no adum nyinaa, dwetɛ mmeaeɛ na ɛbeabea ho; na adihɔ no aboboano nkataano no yɛ adenwono adwuma a wɔde bibire ne asaawa a ɛbere dum ne koogyan ne asaawa fitaa a wɔafira na ayɛ, na ne tentene yɛ basafa du, na ne sorokorɔ wɔ ne trɛ mu yɛ basafa mmienu ne fa, te sɛ adihɔ no ho ntwamutam no; na n’adum nnan, ne ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ nnyinasoɔ nnan, ne nnadewa yɛ dwetɛ, na ne tiri nnuraho ne ne mmeamu yɛ dwetɛ. Na tenabea no ne adihɔ no ho mpɛɛwa a ɛtwa ho hyia no nyinaa yɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ.

Yei ne tenabea no, adanseɛ tenabea no ho nnoɔma anobuo, sɛdeɛ wɔnam Mose anomu asɛm so maa Ɔsɔfoɔ Aaron ba Itamar buu ano maa Lewifoɔ som no. Na Hur ba Uri ba Besalel a ɔfiri Yuda abusuakuo mu no yɛɛ deɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no nyinaa; na deɛ ɔka ne ho ne Ahisamak ba Oholiab a ɔfiri Dan abusuakuo mu a ɔyɛ sika ne dua dwumfoɔ ne ɔnwomfoɔ a ɔde bibire ne asaawa a ɛbere dum ne koogyan ne asaawa fitaa mu adwini no.
Sika a wɔde yɛɛ adwuma no nyinaa, kronkronbea no ho nnwuma nyinaa, ɛtoɔ sika no, ano si dwetikɛseɛ aduonu nkron ne nnwetɛbena ahanson aduasa, sɛdeɛ kronkronbea dwetɛbena no teɛ. Na asafo no mu nnipa a wɔkan wɔn no dwetɛ ano si dwetikɛseɛ ɔha ne nnwetɛbena apem ahanson aduɔson nnum, sɛdeɛ kronkronbea dwetɛbena no teɛ. Wɔn a wɔkan wɔn fraa dodoɔ no mu a wɔadi mfirinhyia aduonu anaa deɛ ɛboro saa a wɔyɛ mpem ahansia ne mpensa ne ahanum aduonum no mu biara yii beka baako (a ɛyɛ dwetɛbena fa sɛdeɛ kronkronbea dwetɛbena no teɛ). Na wɔde dwetɛ dwetikɛseɛ ɔha no guu kronkronbea no nnyinasoɔ ne ntwamutam no nnyinasoɔ no, nnyinasoɔ ɔha no yɛ dwetikɛseɛ ɔha, dwetikɛseɛ baako yɛ nnyinasoɔ baako. Na nnwetɛbena apem ahanson aduɔson nnum no, ɔde yɛɛ adum no mprɛngo, na ɔde bi duraduraa etire tire, na ɔde bi beabeaa ho. Na ɛtoɔ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ no ano si dwetikɛseɛ aduɔson ne nnwetɛbena mpem mmienu ahanan. Na ɛno na ɔde yɛɛ ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano nnyinasoɔ ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ afɔrebukyia ne ɛho kɔbere mfrafraeɛ ntentan ne afɔrebukyia no ho nnoɔma nyinaa, ne adihɔ no nnyinasoɔ a ɛtwa ho hyia, ne adihɔ no aboboano nnyinasoɔ, ne tenabea no ho mpɛɛwa nyinaa, ne adihɔ no mpɛɛwa a ɛtwa ho hyia nyinaa.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
